what: Blind review of the first screen a new user sees, captured on this Mac (Trek's isolated first run; the others as installed: Claude, Capy and Warp never signed in, Conductor at sign-up, Paseo and super.engineering freshly installed, Zed's start page). Unlabelled A-H, separate read-only sub-agent. Scores 1-10.

on_E_trek.best: Says what the product is, that setup is short and optional, that data stays on the machine; asks for no account or permissions; the pixel figure walking to a signpost gives it identity.
faults: the 'Get started' button is small next to the wide card row
white on the light orange button is likely about 3:1
grey card body text on dark grey is only moderate
small illustration in a lot of empty space

caveats: A and B may have been caught mid-animation; G shows a machine-specific gateway screen; H says 'Welcome back'; one static frame each, contrast eyeballed. Trek's next screens ask for 7 macOS permissions, which this frame doesn't show.
